Definition: little; (in number) few; (in age) young, (in value) ignoble
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsâʻîyr, meaning little; few; young, ignoble. It appears 22 times in Scripture, including Genesis 19:31 and Genesis 25:23.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsâʻîyr matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
